en: Color postcard showing an ornate stone fountain with a tall, richly decorated central pillar topped by a small roof-like structure. Around the base are four bronze animal heads (likely oxen) spouting water into a circular basin. The fountain stands in a flower bed in front of a historic building with arched windows and doorways. The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, an orange Hungarian postage stamp, and printed caption information along the edge.
